chr.description: Mouse chromosome the element lies on, prefixed with 'chr'. Scaffolds and patch regions use UCSC-style names.

start.description: Start of the element, 0-based and inclusive.

end.description: End of the mouse element on mm10, 0-based and exclusive.

method.description: Name of the experimental class or prediction model that produced this result.

type.description: Category of element: a mouse DNase hypersensitive site paired to a human site by FUNCODE.

source.description: The database, dataset or organization that is a source for these data.

accessible_via.return: _id, chr, start, end, method, type, source, source_url, name
